name: Refactor
description: Restructure code without changing external behavior.

clarifying_questions.question: Is this a rename of any public symbol?
Are you extracting logic to a new module?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-REFACTOR01
  TYPE: REFACTOR:EXTRACT
  SCOPE: src/module/large-file.ts
  MODULES: module-a
  RISK CAP: MEDIUM
  PROMISES:
    1. All tests pass → verify: test_passes
    2. Behavior identical → verify: diff_inspection
    3. Public API unchanged → verify: diff_inspection
  STATUS: proposed
